title: Diamond Heist: The Shimmering Scheme
story: In the glitzy city of Diamondville, a dazzling event caught everyone's eye - the annual Diamond Jubilee auction. Guests gathered at the luxurious Diamond Palace, where valuable gems were displayed like precious crown jewels. Among them, the Crown Diamond, a breathtaking 1000-carat gem, was the star attraction. Dressed in tuxedos and gowns, attendees speculated on the lucky bidder who would claim the treasure trove. On the night of the auction, one particular gem caught the eye of an ambitious thief.
victim: The Diamond Jubilee Auction Organizer, Ms. Elsa Stones
forensicClue: The distinct scent of lavender found at the crime scene
question: Who stole the Crown Diamond and how was the scent of lavender connected?
